Top college football predictions for Week 12

One of the top Week 12 college football picks the model is recommending for the best betting apps: No. 8 Indiana (-7.5, 44.5) covers at Washington in a 3:30 p.m. ET kickoff. Already boasting the No. 4 scoring defense in the nation, IU's offense got a huge boost with seventh-year QB Grant Wilson. In his first start, the Hoosiers posted a season high of 305 passing yards in a Saturday win over then-No. 18 USC. That provides Indiana with balance, which is something Washington lacks. The Huskies are outside the top 10 of the Big Ten in both scoring offense and scoring defense, and they also have the worst ATS home record in the country (0-6). Indiana covers well over 60% of the time, while the Over connects in well over 60% of sims in an A-rated total pick.

Another Week 12 prediction: No. 5 Texas (-20.5, 47.5) covers at home versus Arkansas. The Longhorns have won four straight, three coming against top 25 teams at the time. Arkansas is coming off an upset victory over South Carolina, but the Hogs are 0-3 ATS following a win this season. They're also 2-4 versus the spread against ranked opponents, and Razorbacks QB KJ Jackson has a 2:3 TD:INT in road games this season. Arch Manning is forecasted to have over 250 passing yards and 2 passing touchdowns, while RB Raleek Brown has nearly 120 scrimmage yards.
